candidate_relations.reason: The label 'starvation-induced colitis' captures the same diagnostic object as 'starvation colitis' — colitis caused by starvation/prolonged fasting — with no missing components. The clinical record supports this: prolonged hunger strike, bloody diarrhea, colonic wall thickening on ultrasound, diffuse granular/friable mucosa on endoscopy, and biopsy showing active colitis with cryptitis and crypt abscesses, with negative infectious workup.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Starvation-induced colitis is a direct alias of starvation colitis, same entity and etiology

candidate_relations.reason: While the histological findings (cryptitis, crypt abscesses, goblet cell depletion) overlap with IBD, the clinical context (hunger strike, resolution on follow-up biopsy, negative infectious workup) points to starvation colitis as the specific etiology. IBD implies a chronic idiopathic inflammatory condition, conflicting with the starvation-related etiology of the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: IBD (with parenthetical) is a broader category that includes Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis; the reference diagnosis is a specific etiology-defined entity distinct from idiopathic IBD

candidate_relations.reason: Identical to C002 in substance — 'Inflammatory Bowel Disease' is a broader, etiology-conflicting category relative to starvation colitis. The reference diagnosis is etiologically specific (starvation/hunger strike), whereas IBD denotes chronic idiopathic disease.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Same reasoning as C002; IBD without parenthetical is still the broader idiopathic category

candidate_relations.reason: In this case, the starvation is caused by a hunger strike, making 'hunger strike-associated colitis' a clinically accurate and complete equivalent of 'starvation colitis.' The etiology (prolonged food deprivation), anatomy (colon), and pathological findings are all captured. This is an acceptable alias in the context of this case.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Hunger strike-associated colitis is a contextually specific alias for starvation colitis in this clinical scenario
